insights.title: NVIDIA: 36% down
insights.text: NVIDIA is 36% below its peak. 2 of 23 completed 10%+ corrections since 2011 went deeper than this. The typical one took 5 weeks to recover from the trough.

insights.title: Nasdaq 100: 16% down
insights.text: Nasdaq 100 is 16% below its peak. 4 of 9 completed 10%+ corrections since 2011 went deeper than this. The typical one took 12 weeks to recover from the trough.

insights.title: Bitcoin: 51% down
insights.text: Bitcoin is 51% below its peak. 2 of 15 completed 10%+ corrections since 2011 went deeper than this. The typical one took 6 weeks to recover from the trough.

insights.title: Gold versus stocks
insights.text: Gold is 31% below its 12-month high while the S&P 500 is 8% below its own. Gold is falling at least as hard: this is broad deleveraging, not a flight to safety.

insights.title: How often the S&P falls this far
insights.text: Since late 2011 the S&P 500 has had 6 weekly-close corrections of 10% or more, 2 of 20%+. It is now 8% below its peak.

insights.title: Silver amplifies gold
insights.text: Silver's median 10%+ correction since 2011 was 59% deep, against 33% for gold. It is now 58% off its 12-month high.
